caption: The example flips good to −2 after not and keeps excellent as +3, so the total is +1 positive; the aspect panel then keeps film −2 and songs +3 separate. Notice that the +1 total hides the opposite aspect signs.

spec.title: Lexicon scoring of the worked example
spec.aria: A rightward flow starts with tokens not, good, but, excellent, songs; applies lexicon scores good +2 and excellent +3; flips good to −2 after not; sums to total +1 positive; and shows aspects film −2 and songs +3.
